hotspots.title: Adorni scandal deepens
hotspots.blurb: Manuel Adorni, former Chief of Staff to Argentine President Javier Milei, resigned amid allegations of illicit enrichment, including undeclared payments and asset inconsistencies. His resignation has triggered a political reshuffle, with Diego Santilli appointed as his successor.
hotspots.affect: The scandal has dominated coverage due to its moral and legal implications, polarizing public opinion and destabilizing Milei's government.

hotspots.title: Meloni targets right-wing Quirinale
hotspots.blurb: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has signaled her intent to break tradition by nominating a right-wing president for Italy's Quirinale in 2027, challenging the left's historical dominance. This move has sparked debates about Italy's political future and Meloni's long-term strategy.
hotspots.affect: The proposal has ignited intense debate due to its symbolic and political significance, reflecting broader tensions within Italy's right-wing coalition.

hotspots.title: Trump-Meloni feud escalates
hotspots.blurb: Relations between U.S. President Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni have deteriorated sharply, with public exchanges of criticism over NATO policies, U.S. base usage, and personal insults. The feud has raised concerns about transatlantic unity.
hotspots.affect: The escalating tensions have drawn disproportionate attention due to the high stakes of U.S.-Italy relations and the personal animosity between the leaders.

hotspots.title: Farage’s £5m donation scandal
hotspots.blurb: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage faces scrutiny over a £5 million donation from crypto billionaire Christopher Harborne, with questions about the donation's conditions and Farage's transparency. The scandal has fueled debates about political funding and Reform UK's credibility.
hotspots.affect: The controversy has commanded intense media focus due to its implications for political integrity and the potential influence of wealthy donors on UK politics.

hotspots.title: AfD ban debate intensifies
hotspots.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) faces renewed calls for a ban following reports alleging constitutional violations and extremist ties. The debate has divided political parties and raised questions about democratic safeguards.
hotspots.affect: The debate has generated significant heat due to its implications for Germany's democratic institutions and the rise of far-right politics in Europe.
